QF.id: XXVA Regulatory Compliance for Non-Core Research Personnel_25

question.text: The Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) mechanism in the context of research services:

answer.text: Is available only for disputes above Rs.10 lakh
Provides a technology-driven platform for resolving disputes between investors and market participants including research entities through mediation, conciliation, and arbitration
Replaces the need for SCORES entirely
Is optional and investors cannot compel research entities to participate

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 26A submits RA / research-entity client disputes to a dispute resolution mechanism that includes mediation, conciliation, and arbitration, and the Investor Charter escalates unresolved complaints to SMARTODR for online conciliation or arbitration. The Trap: The other options invent a minimum-amount threshold, treat ODR as a replacement for SCORES, or frame participation as fully optional — none of which are stated in the checked pages. Note: The checked pages do not support claims that ODR has no minimum dispute amount, covers all market participants, compels participation, or always produces binding resolutions; those details are intentionally left out.
